descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a QC Inspector to join our GT Aero team in Aberdeen. Are you detail-focused and passionate about engineering quality? Join our expert GT Aero team in Aberdeen, where you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring the integrity and compliance of our gas turbine overhaul and inspection operations. Be part of a company committed to technical excellence and sustainability within the energy transition. Job Responsibilities:
• Perform bulk and detail strip inspections of gas turbines and provide comprehensive defect reports
• Carry out stage inspections during engine builds to ensure compliance with quality standards
• Maintain and control workshop Control Order Files and associated documentation
• Ensure all measuring equipment is calibrated, certified, and aligned with Quality Management System requirements
• Assist with shipping and receipt of materials to and from approved vendors, expediting sub-con activities efficiently Job Qualifications:
• Previous experience in a similar inspection or mechanical quality role, ideally within a gas turbine environment
• Proven ability to understand and interpret engineering drawings and illustrated parts catalogues
• Working knowledge of industrial or power gas turbines and associated components
• A minimum of NC in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; HNC is preferred (or suitable proven experience in lieu of formal qualifications)
• Strong organisational skills and ability to work collaboratively with workshop and quality teams What we offer you
• Enjoy a better work-life balance with our 9-day fortnight, giving you a three-day weekend every other week
• Competitive base salary
• Inclusion in a company-wide bonus program
• Attractive overtime pay scheme
• 33 days of annual leave
• Private medical insurance
• On-site parking
• Access to various discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle
• An Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support services, including counselling and resources to help manage personal and work-related issues, enhancing overall well-being and productivity
• Continuous learning and development opportunities through on-the-job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways, our dedicated online platform for professional growth Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
